isolation: The catalogue (library-service) is static, seeded once at startup and read-only for the life of the deployment (specs/design/domain-model.md, library-service/book_store.bal) -- nothing is created per scenario. Every Given was verified by reading the CURRENT catalogue straight from library-service's own intranet-only endpoint (exposure: intranet, no auth, never mutated by any route), so each read is sound regardless of what else runs concurrently. No scenario reached its When: book-buddy is the only interface (type ai-agent, no web-application in this project) and exposesAPI.auth: end-user-required, so every When needed a real end-user OAuth bearer token. The registered OAuth client_id that a sign-in needs is platform-provisioned and was not obtainable through any interface available to this run -- see each scenario's blocked step for the evidence gathered before concluding that.

scenarios.rule: A Team Member can search the catalogue by genre
scenarios.scenario: Asking for a genre with matches

steps.text: the catalogue holds mystery novels including "The Silent Patient"
steps.observed: count 3, data includes {id: b1, title: "The Silent Patient", genre: mystery} -- precondition holds

steps.text: Priya asks book-buddy for a mystery novel to read
steps.command: curl -X POST https://development-default.apps.94.72.97.95.sslip.io/ai-agent-bookbuddy-book-buddy-http/chat -d '{"message":"Can you recommend a mystery novel?"}'
steps.observed: HTTP 401 {"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Authentication failed"} both with no Authorization header and with a bogus bearer token, confirming the gateway is enforcing end-user auth. book-buddy has no web UI (type: ai-agent, no web-application component in this project) -- POST /chat is the only interface. Completing the OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE sign-in the roles-gate ticket (#3) describes requires this project's registered OAuth client_id (the `user-auth` thunder-app dependency's platform-provisioned client). That id is not published in the validation issue, not in /tmp/validation-context.json, not in the roles-gate ticket, not in any environment variable on this pod, and the IdP's dynamic client registration endpoint (https://default-idp.../oauth2/dcr/register) refuses an unauthenticated registration attempt with `unauthorized_client`. No control exists to disable/enable -- there is no UI at all -- and the API attempt is answered 401 before any conversation turn can happen. The action could not be performed at any reachable interface.
